verdict.rationale: Vue ships versioned major releases (npm version badge) with a first-party 'Migration from Vue 2' guide and a 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2' page, which point to versioned APIs and end-of-life handling for older majors. The pack contains no explicit deprecation policy or support timeline. missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation policy, semver/support-window commitments, deprecation-warning process details, independent corroboration.
